Alex R.: Quick one — need to swap my primary shift tonight, running into a family thing. Primary is 00:00-08:00 UTC. Can someone cover? I can be secondary until 02:00 UTC if that helps.
Maya P.: I can take primary but I can’t start until 02:00 UTC. If Alex can be primary until 02:00, I can take 02:00-08:00.
Sam K.: I’m +1 to cover full 00:00-08:00 if needed, but I’m on-call pager for infra tonight too. Can do backup if Maya takes half.
Alex R.: Thanks — I can definitely stay primary until 02:00. Prefer Maya for 02:00-08:00 if she’s ok.
Maya P.: OK I’ll take 02:00-08:00. Can we do the formal swap so the rotation tool and PagerDuty reflect it? Also need runbook links in the thread for whoever’s new primary.
oncall-bot: Rotation request detected: swap request from Alex R. -> Maya P. for 2026-03-14T00:00Z to 2026-03-14T08:00Z. Approval required from oncall-admins.
Jordan L.: I’ll confirm the swap and run the change in the oncall console now. Reminder: if there’s any customer-impacting page, follow the "prod-paging" runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prod-paging and post customer impact in #incidents.
Sam K.: quick note — there’s a maintenance window starting 06:00 UTC that might trigger noisy alerts. Maya FYI. Consider muting non-critical infra alerts 06:00-06:30.
Maya P.: good call, thanks. Can someone paste the most common quick-ack commands?
Jordan L.: Ack/resolve cheatsheet:
```
# acknowledge the alert in PD
pdctl alert ack <alert_id>
# add note in thread
pdctl alert note <alert_id> "taking primary now"
# escalate to SRE lead
pdctl alert escalate <alert_id> --to sre-lead
```
Alex R.: Leaving a short handoff: current open watchlist: high latency on vembed service (investigation ongoing, mitigations: scaled pool + temporary caching), email alerts to eng-runtime on high token queue length. No customer outages atm.
Maya P.: Got it. I’ll monitor vembed and the token queue from 02:00. I’ll mute noise from the maintenance window and leave notes if anything looks like regression.
Jordan L.: Swap performed in console and PagerDuty updated — oncall-bot confirmed. New primary: Maya P. 02:00-08:00 UTC, Alex R. remains secondary 00:00-02:00 UTC. pd_change_id=chg_20260314_001. :white_check_mark:
